email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoGlutide patient with sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a clinical care coordinator at Demo Family Practice (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

Our patient, a male in their 70s with type 2 diabetes, was given DemoGlutide, at a dose of 5 mg, (fourth dose).
Treatment started on 2026-06-13.
About 2 days later, they developed sudden difficulty breathing and facial swelling.
The patient was hospitalized as a result.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
D. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Demo Family Practice
Contact: demo.reporter759@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
